# Reusable skills — Session 3
- `requirement-analysis/SKILL.md`: story analysis, ambiguity, criteria.
- `api-test-design/SKILL.md`: criteria-to-test mapping and API edge cases.
- `change-validation/SKILL.md`: build, tests, local verification, Playwright, evidence.
- `pr-preparation/SKILL.md`: diff, test evidence, secret check, PR summary.
- `jira-to-pr/SKILL.md`: end-to-end Jira-to-PR workflow used by the `jira-to-pr` orchestrator agent.

Agents reference relevant skills by name. Discovery and automatic invocation vary by runtime; verify before the workshop.
